name: Fix shared state pollution causing test suite failure across files
description: Add clearMetrics() reset helper to src/metrics.ts so tests in test/metrics-a.test.ts and test/metrics-b.test.ts do not pollute shared singleton state.

inputs.task_prompt: test/metrics-b.test.ts passes when run individually, but fails when the entire test suite runs because globalMetrics in src/metrics.ts accumulates counts from test/metrics-a.test.ts. Add an exported resetMetrics() function to src/metrics.ts and call it in beforeEach in the test files to isolate state cleanly. Both tests must pass when run together.

acceptance_criteria: resetMetrics() exported from src/metrics.ts resets counts to 0
Full test suite (bun test) passes with all tests green
No state leaks between test files
